name: Detail-based Segmentation
definition: A divide-and-conquer approach that represents a whole scene with multiple NeRFs by segmenting objects based on their detail frequency, assigning high-frequency objects to individual NeRFs and low-frequency objects to a joint NeRF.
summary: Detail-based Segmentation partitions scenes into dedicated and shared NeRFs using frequency analysis, unlike methods relying on semantic labels or geometry.
